# HoldRole

**Enum** · namespace `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Interaction/PhysicsHold.cs#L35)

What part one hand plays in a hold. Deliberately not `GripRole`: a grip point is an
authoring concept the hold knows nothing about, and the grab layer translates between the two.

```csharp
public enum HoldRole
```

## Fields

### Positions {#positions}

`Positions = 1`

This hand decides where the object is and how it is rolled. A rifle's grip.

### Shared {#shared}

`Shared = 0`

Neither hand outranks the other. Two hands on a barrel.

### Steadies {#steadies}

`Steadies = 2`

This hand aims it and takes its position from the hand that positions. A rifle's foregrip.

Alone it stands in as the positioning hand, because an object with a hand on it has to be
somewhere - but weakly, at [`oneHandedStrength`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/HoldSettings#onehandedstrength).
